correctness.rationale: Derive the rank-one pseudoinverse of L(K_{p,q})-bb^T on the zero-sum space and square it; certify exactly two possible positive mixed orbit classes with common entry F/D. Four displayed positive-coefficient polynomials prove strict negativity of every other off-diagonal class for all p,q>=2. Barycentric facet gradients connect Gram signs to interior angle signs, and a one-root quadratic with balanced evaluations establishes n=25 and the sqrt(n) threshold. CHECK.py replays symbolic identities and 36 independent exact inversions; no finite run replaces the polynomial sign proof.

value.rationale: The structurally natural deletion of just one graph edge produces a sharp, complete acute/obtuse sign phase of all Euclidean ridges, even though every polytope remains a simplex. A first non-obtuse-only case occurs at graph order 25 and an exact quadratic threshold yields a sqrt(n) stability scale with 5/2 offset. This is a motivated robustness boundary for canonical graph-based Euclidean polytopes, not simply a routine alternate angle enumeration.
